title: Famous MEGA HOUSE! *Sleeps 20* Big Patio/Backyard
description:
TWO gorgeous side-by-side homes (the Famous CASH House & the Famous DOLLY House) for you and your family & friends! Accommodates 20 easily and has plenty of outdoor space and a shared backyard.  The perfect home and Nashville location for your large group to stay!

Bachelors and bachelorettes, families, corporate retreats, reunions...this one is for you!

The space
Home at a glance:

• City Skyline View from the Backyard & Patios.
• Free Private Parking for 4 cars + Driveway Space.
• Easy Uber to Downtown, Germantown, 5 Points, Bridgestone Arena, etc.
• Multiple Outdoor Areas.
• 6 Bedrooms & 14 Beds plus air mattresses.  Easily sleeps 20!
• 6 Full Bathrooms, 2 Half Bathrooms.
• Perfect for Large Groups: Families, Reunions, Work, Bachelor/ette.
•  65" SMART TV's in the living room(s) and 50" SMART TV's in all bedrooms.

Two side-by-side units with a total of 6 bedrooms each with 3.5 bathrooms and fully stocked kitchens.

The entire attached Townhomes and private decks with a spacious, shared backyard are included in this rental! Make it cozy, make it your home away from home!

ROOMS:

• Bedroom 1: Top floor- Queen bed with en suite bathroom
• Bedroom 2: Queen bed + convertible sleeper sofa and en suite bathroom
• Bedroom 3:  Bunk room-4 queen beds(queen over queen bunks) with en suite bathroom.
• Bedroom 4: Top floor-Queen bed with en suite bathroom.
• Bedroom 5: Queen bed + pullout sleeper sofa
• Bedroom 6: Bunk room-4 queen beds(queen over queen bunks) with en suite bathroom.

• Other options: One queen pullout couch(on one side) and we can provide additional air mattresses and up to (2) pack n plays upon request.

Guest access
The entire home and outdoors areas are yours for the length of your stay.

Other things to note
As pictured there are stairs to get to the bedrooms but we do have sofa beds on the first floor.  We do monitor our outdoor cameras to make sure rules are followed.
